bib:henke_operator.title: Operator: Technology
bib:henke_operator.notes: Henke confirms Operator is phase modulation, not strict FM. Defines the 'PM is FM up to 90 degrees' equivalence used throughout the script.

bib:chowning_1973.title: The Synthesis of Complex Audio Spectra by Means of Frequency Modulation
bib:chowning_1973.publisher: Journal of the Audio Engineering Society
bib:chowning_1973.notes: Foundational FM paper. Rejected by several journals before JAES accepted it.

bib:patent_us_4018121.title: Method of Synthesizing a Musical Sound
bib:patent_us_4018121.notes: Stanford's second-most-lucrative patent. Generated ~$22.9M in royalties.

bib:tape_op_89_squarepusher.title: Squarepusher Interview
bib:tape_op_89_squarepusher.notes: Squarepusher on FM synth setup and recording approach.

bib:sos_tingen_squarepusher_2011.title: Squarepusher: Inside the Studio
bib:sos_tingen_squarepusher_2011.notes: Confirms TX81Z + FS1R rig. Quote on Go Plastic gear: 'Yamaha QY700, TX81Z and FS1R, Eventide DSP4000 and Orville, Akai S6000, Mackie 16 channel desk.'

bib:watmm_autechre_ama_2013.title: Autechre AMA on We Are The Music Makers
bib:watmm_autechre_ama_2013.notes: Booth confirms FM is favourite synthesis mode; line-between-sequencing-and-synthesis quote.

bib:future_music_aphex_1993.title: Aphex Twin Interview
bib:future_music_aphex_1993.notes: Lists rig: Roland SH-101, Korg MS-20, Yamaha DX7 through Alesis Quadraverb.

bib:future_music_eno_1995.title: Brian Eno on the DX7
bib:future_music_eno_1995.notes: Eno: 'I use the DX7 because I understand it. I was quite ill for a while, and I filled the time by learning it.'

bib:keyboard_eno_patches_1987.title: Brian Eno's DX7 Patches: Glide, Kalimba 2, Tamboura, Violin 3
bib:keyboard_eno_patches_1987.notes: Republished by CDM in 2017. Glide patch is the basis of An Ending (Ascent).

bib:reverb_machine_xtal_2022.title: Aphex Twin's Xtal: Sample Identification
bib:reverb_machine_xtal_2022.notes: Identifies the chord bed as a 1986 library sample from 'Evil at Play'. The bell motif and 'Actium' rely on DX7 ROM 11 E.PIANO 1.

bib:gearspace_lanois_apollo.title: Daniel Lanois on the Apollo Sessions
bib:gearspace_lanois_apollo.notes: Lanois quote: 'On top of that, we put all the DX7 sounds through a Mesa Boogie.' Main synth identified as Yamaha CS-80.

bib:korg_takahashi_aphex_2017.title: Tatsuya Takahashi Interviews Richard D. James
bib:korg_takahashi_aphex_2017.notes: Aphex Twin: 'The first thoughts I had about tuning happened with my early noodlings on a Yamaha DX100, one of the first synths I saved up for.'

bib:yamaha_hub_chowning.title: John Chowning: The Discovery of FM
bib:yamaha_hub_chowning.notes: Source of Chowning's 'discovery of the ear' quotes and the ten-minutes-Ishimura anecdote.

bib:mix_online_stanford_patent.title: Stanford's $22.9M FM Patent
bib:mix_online_stanford_patent.notes: Royalty totals for US 4,018,121 over its lifetime.

bib:cytomic_filter_models.title: Cytomic Analog Filter Models in Ableton Live
bib:cytomic_filter_models.notes: OSR (Oxford OSCar), MS2 (Korg MS-20), SMP, PRD (Moog Prodigy) circuit models. Live 9.5+.

bib:carson_1922.title: Notes on the Theory of Modulation
bib:carson_1922.notes: Carson's bandwidth rule: BW ≈ 2(I+1)f_m. Captures ≥98% of FM signal power for 1 ≤ I ≤ 5.

bib:gearnews_dx100_detroit.title: How the DX100 Defined Detroit Techno Bass
bib:gearnews_dx100_detroit.notes: DX100 was 'caned by the Detroit techno guys, especially Derrick May.'

bib:caesura_autechre_elseq.title: Autechre's elseq 1-5 and the FM Question
bib:caesura_autechre_elseq.notes: Frames FM's centrality to Autechre's practice; cites Eno's claim that FM is the synthesis method by which one learns the most about sound.
